items.prompt: How does al-Ājurrūmiyya define the particle?
options: A word that takes none of the signs of the noun or the verb
A word that names a thing
A word with a time in it
items.explanation: The particle is known by what it lacks: no sign of the noun, no sign of the verb.
Fī is a particle of khafḍ: al-bayti ends in kasra after it.

items.prompt: Which of these words is a particle?
items.explanation: Lam is a particle that puts the present tense into jazm.
